variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The ticket is loading: the header shows Ticket with a placeholder line, the thread, the properties, the requester and the activity show their skeletons and the composer is disabled.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: The ticket could not load: the header stays and a danger Alert with Retry takes the page body's place.

variants.name: Sending
variants.summary: A reply is on its way: Send spins, the editor is read-only and the composer is marked busy, with the draft still in view.

variants.name: SendError
variants.summary: The reply was not sent: the composer keeps the draft and shows a danger Alert with Retry above the editor.

variants.name: Solved
variants.summary: A solved ticket: the status Tag reads Solved, the SLA countdown is gone and the composer gives way to This ticket is solved with Reopen.

variants.name: InternalNote
variants.summary: The composer on Internal note: the warning edge, the lock line Only your team can see internal notes, no recipients, a draft that mentions a teammate and Add note in place of Send.
